title.rendered: Compact Portable Car Sheds: Convenient and Protective Shelters for Your Vehicle

content.rendered:
Looking for a strong, made-to-order car parking shed that keeps your vehicles safe from sun, rain and dust? A portable car shed from SAMAN Portable is a custom steel structure, fabricated to your size and site after you place an order — not a fabric kit, a plastic cover or a ready-made pop-up shelter.

At SAMAN Portable we manufacture car parking sheds as engineered steel and MS structures, built on a clean, new mild-steel frame and finished with steel roofing sheets. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we fabricate at our own factories in Bengaluru and Greater Noida and deliver across India.

A portable car shed is a practical choice for homes, factories, sites, farmhouses, villas, parking areas, warehouses, institutions and commercial premises that need covered parking without the cost and permanence of conventional construction. Each unit is fabricated after enquiry, so the size, height and roofing suit your vehicles and your space.

Key Takeaways

  • Custom steel / MS car sheds, fabricated to order — not stocked ready-made
  • Built on a new mild-steel frame with steel roofing sheets
  • Sized for a single car, multiple cars or larger commercial parking
  • Suitable for homes, factories, sites, warehouses and institutions
  • Engineered for Indian weather and long service life
  • Direct from the manufacturer, with delivery and installation support

What This Page Covers

This page explains the steel car parking sheds SAMAN Portable builds to order: what we supply, what we do not supply, the common sizes and structure options, where these sheds are used, how customisation works, and the factors that decide your price and delivery. If you want a covered parking structure built around your vehicles and site, this is the right starting point.

What SAMAN Supplies

SAMAN Portable manufactures custom steel and MS car sheds and carports on order. Each shed is made-to-order — fabricated after your enquiry, not picked from ready stock.

  • Steel / MS / tubular car parking sheds, designed for your size and layout
  • PEB-style framed sheds where the span or load needs an engineered structure
  • New mild-steel frames with steel roof sheeting, suited to Indian site conditions
  • Single-vehicle, multi-vehicle and commercial parking configurations
  • Delivery and installation support across India where structurally suitable

You share your requirement; we fabricate the shed to match it.

What SAMAN Does Not Supply

To keep things honest, here is what a SAMAN car shed is not:

  • Not a fabric, canvas or PVC cover
  • Not a polyethylene or plastic garage
  • Not a pop-up or fold-up carport
  • Not a DIY or self-assembly kit
  • Not a ready-made, off-the-shelf stock item

We build engineered steel structures fabricated after order. If you need a quick consumer cover, that is a different product; if you need a durable steel car shed made to last, that is what we manufacture.

Common Custom Sizes and Size Factors

Because every shed is made to order, there is no fixed catalogue size. The right size depends on a few simple factors:

  • Number and type of vehicles — car, SUV, multiple cars or commercial vehicles
  • Clear height needed for doors, roof rails or taller vehicles
  • The footprint and shape of your available parking area
  • Whether you want an open carport, a covered shed or a partly enclosed structure
  • Future plans — extra bays or an extension later

Share your plot dimensions and how many vehicles you need to cover, and our team will recommend a workable size and column layout for your site.

Steel / MS Structure and Roofing Options

A SAMAN car shed is engineered, not improvised. We use new, structural-grade steel and proven roofing systems rather than light consumer materials.

  • Structural steel / MS frame, with sections chosen for the span and load
  • Galvanised or powder-coated finish for corrosion resistance
  • Steel roofing sheets, with insulated panel options where heat control matters
  • Cantilever (single-column) or multi-column designs to suit the site
  • Open, semi-covered or partly enclosed layouts as required

Structural steel for our framed work is specified to IS 2062, so the frame, columns and roof are matched to the loads of your location.

Applications

Custom steel car sheds suit a wide range of buyers wherever covered parking is needed and the site is structurally suitable:

  • Homes, villas and farmhouses needing covered parking
  • Factories and warehouses protecting vehicles and loading areas
  • Construction and project sites needing on-site vehicle cover
  • Parking areas for offices, institutions and commercial premises
  • Apartment, society and campus parking where a steel structure is preferred

Customisation

Made-to-order means the shed is shaped around your needs, not the other way round. Common customisation choices include:

  • Overall size, number of bays and clear height
  • Open carport, covered shed or partly enclosed design
  • Roof profile and sheeting, including insulated options
  • Column position and layout to fit existing parking
  • Finish and colour to match your premises

To plan your shed, share the size, site location, roofing preference, column or support requirement, and the installation conditions at your site.

Price Factors (No Fixed Price)

Because every car shed is fabricated to order, the price is quoted after we understand your requirement. There is no single standard rate. The main factors are:

  • Overall size and number of vehicles covered
  • Steel section and frame design needed for the span and load
  • Type and grade of roof sheeting
  • Clear height of the structure
  • Foundation and site conditions
  • Delivery distance and installation requirements

Tell us your size and location and we will prepare a clear quotation for your specific shed.

Delivery and Installation Factors

A car shed installs smoothly when the site is ready. The main requirements are a level, well-drained base and clear access for delivery and assembly.

  1. Site survey and measurement
  2. Ground levelling and base or foundation preparation
  3. Frame and column erection
  4. Roof sheeting and finishing
  5. Final inspection and handover

Delivery timelines and installation depend on the size, your site conditions and location. Our team advises on the right base and access so the structure stands square and stable.

Why Choose SAMAN Portable

SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel sheds and industrial sheds, building from our own factories in Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308. As a factory-direct supplier we control quality from steel to handover, and our framed structures are backed by a clear warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.

For a deeper look at our steel-shed range, see our guide to industrial sheds. When you are ready, tell us your size, location and vehicles, and we will recommend the right car shed for your site.

Get a quote: Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form, and our team will help you plan your custom steel car shed.

Conclusion

A portable car shed from SAMAN Portable is a made-to-order steel structure that protects your vehicles for years — not a fabric cover or a ready-made kit. Built on a new MS frame with steel roofing and fabricated to your size and site, it gives homes, factories, sites and commercial premises durable covered parking with the backing of a real manufacturer and a real warranty.

FAQ

Is a SAMAN portable car shed a fabric or pop-up cover?

No. SAMAN car sheds are engineered steel / MS structures fabricated to order. We do not supply fabric, PVC, plastic or pop-up covers, and we do not sell ready-made kits.

Are car sheds made to order or available as ready stock?

They are made to order. Each shed is fabricated after your enquiry to suit your size, vehicles and site, so it is not picked from ready stock.

What sizes of car parking shed can SAMAN build?

Sizes are custom. They depend on the number and type of vehicles, the clear height you need and the footprint of your parking area. Share your plot size and we will recommend a layout.

How much does a custom steel car shed cost?

There is no single fixed price because every shed is made to order. The cost depends on size, steel section, roof sheet, height, foundation and site condition, and transport. We quote after understanding your requirement.

Where can SAMAN install a car shed?

We supply and install across India where the site is structurally suitable, including homes, factories, sites, farmhouses, villas, parking areas, warehouses, institutions and commercial premises.

What do you need from me to plan a car shed?

Please share your required size, site location, roofing preference, column or support requirement, and your installation conditions. With these details we can recommend a design and prepare a quote.
